# AliExpress

> > Global online marketplace connecting consumers with Chinese sellers offering electronics, fashion, home goods, automotive products, and daily deals with free shipping.

AliExpress is Alibaba Group's international retail marketplace featuring millions of products across categories like consumer electronics (iPhone accessories, USB cables), automotive parts (Tesla accessories), fashion, and home goods. The platform specializes in direct-from-manufacturer pricing with worldwide shipping.

## Key Topics

- Chinese marketplace
- Online shopping
- Consumer electronics
- Fashion and apparel
- Daily deals and discounts
- New shopper offers
- Bundle deals
- Home and garden
- Automotive accessories
- Beauty products
- Free shipping
- iPhone accessories
- USB cables (Type C, Lightning, Micro USB)
- Tesla accessories
- Discount shopping

## Main Shopping Experience

- [AliExpress - Affordable Chinese Stores & Free Shipping - Online Shopping](https://aliexpress.com): Main homepage for AliExpress marketplace featuring deals and products
- [AliExpress - Online Shopping for Popular Electronics, Fashion, Home & Garden, Toys & Sports, Automobiles and More.](https://a.aliexpress.com): Alternative homepage showcasing electronics, fashion, and daily deals
- [Main Venue](https://aliexpress.com/ssr/300002955/main-venue-75x8jo): Main product venue landing page with curated shopping collections

## Customer Support

- [Mobile Help Center](https://m.aliexpress.com/helpcenter/index.htm): Mobile help center with FAQs for payment, shipping, and customer support

## Optional

- [Help Center Knowledge Base](https://service.aliexpress.com/page/knowledge): Help Center knowledge base (error page showing Taobao redirect)
- [Help Center Home](https://service.aliexpress.com/page/home): Help Center home for orders, payments, shipping support (error page)
